items.title: 1.5 Introduction to Hyperbolic and Inverse Hyperbolic Functions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 9-10: 1.5 introduction (hyperbolic and inverse hyperbolic functions), printed before 1.5.1

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Ab tak hum ne exponential function \(e^{x}\) ko achhi tarah dekh liya hai. Aaj hum ek naya khandan (family) shuru kar rahe hain jo isi \(e^{x}\) se bana hai: hyperbolic functions. Ghabraiye mat, naam bhari lagta hai magar andar se yeh bilkul \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) ka mel hai. Is page par sirf taaruf (introduction) hai; har cheez agle pages par qadam ba qadam aayegi.

Kitab kehti hai: hyperbolic functions transcendental functions ki ek qisam hain jo exponential functions se bohat qareeb ka rishta rakhti hain. Inhein \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) ko jor kar define kiya jata hai. In ke graphs kuch kuch trigonometric functions jaise lagte hain, lekin yeh circle (daira) se nahin balke hyperbola se paida hote hain. Bunyadi hyperbolic functions \(\sinh x\), \(\cosh x\) aur \(\tanh x\) hain, aur mathematics, physics aur engineering mein in ka bohat istemal hota hai.

Inverse hyperbolic functions, hyperbolic functions ke inverse (ulte) functions hain, jo munasib restricted domains (mehdood kiye hue domains) par define kiye jate hain. Yeh hyperbolic functions wali equations hal karne mein kaam aate hain, aur integration, differential equations aur asal zindagi ke masail ki modeling mein bhi nazar aate hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh kyun parhein? Section 1.4 mein aap ne \(e^{x}\) seekha tha. Hyperbolic functions bas \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) ke do pakke mixture hain:
\(\sinh x\) mein dono ka farq (difference) aur \(\cosh x\) mein dono ka jama (sum) liya jata hai, aur phir 2 se divide kiya jata hai. Is liye \(e^{x}\) ki saari baatein (domain \(\mathbb{R}\), hamesha positive, \(e^{0} = 1\), aur \(x \to -\infty\) par \(e^{x} \to 0\)) is poore section mein hamare auzaar (tools) hongi.
Naam kaise parhein: \(\sinh\) ko "hyperbolic sine" (aksar "shine") kehte hain, \(\cosh\) ko "hyperbolic cosine" ("cosh"), aur \(\tanh\) ko "hyperbolic tangent" ("than").

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Naam "hyperbolic" kyun? Trigonometry mein point \((\cos t, \sin t)\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) par chalta hai. Naye functions mein point \((\cosh t, \sinh t)\) hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) par chalta hai. Naam ki wajah sirf yahi hai, aur Example 9 (page 1.5.1) mein hum ise saabit (prove) karenge.
Zindagi se ek misaal: bijli ki taar ya zanjeer jab do khambon ke darmiyan khud latakti hai to us ki shakal bilkul \(\cosh\) ke graph jaisi hoti hai. Is shakal ko catenary kehte hain. Yani yeh functions sirf kitabi nahin, aap rozana inhein dekhte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Ek baat pehle se zehan mein rakh lijiye: is section mein koi naya mushkil hunar nahin chahiye. Aap ko sirf teen cheezein aani chahiye: exponents ke qaide (jaise \(e^{x} \cdot e^{-x} = 1\)), \((a \pm b)^{2}\) ka formula, aur quadratic formula. Inhi teen auzaaron se hum saari identities saabit karenge aur saare inverse formulas banayenge. Agar in mein se koi kamzor hai to abhi ek nazar dobara daal lijiye; aage ka safar bohat aasan ho jayega.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(e^{0} = 1\) hai. To \(x = 0\) par \(e^{x} - e^{-x}\) kitna hoga, aur \(e^{x} + e^{-x}\) kitna? Socha? Pehla \(1 - 1 = 0\) aur doosra \(1 + 1 = 2\). Agle page par aap dekhenge ke is se \(\sinh 0 = 0\) aur \(\cosh 0 = 1\) nikalta hai, bilkul \(\sin 0 = 0\) aur \(\cos 0 = 1\) ki tarah.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: (Yeh misaal kitab ki nahin, hamari taraf se hai.) Maan lijiye \(x = 1\). Calculator se \(e^{1} \approx 2.718\) aur \(e^{-1} \approx 0.368\). Farq \(2.350\) hai, aadha \(1.175\): yeh \(\sinh 1\) hai. Jama \(3.086\) hai, aadha \(1.543\): yeh \(\cosh 1\) hai. Dekha? Sirf \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) ki values chahiye thin, aur dono hyperbolic values nikal aayin.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Hyperbolic functions transcendental hain, aur \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) se bante hain.
2. In ke graphs thore trigonometric graphs jaise lagte hain, magar yeh hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) se aate hain, circle se nahin.
3. Bunyadi functions: \(\sinh x\), \(\cosh x\), \(\tanh x\).
4. Inverse hyperbolic functions munasib (kabhi restricted) domain par mojood hote hain aur \(\ln\) ki shakal mein likhe jate hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\sinh x\) ko \(\sin(hx)\) ya \(\sin x\) ko \(h\) se multiply samajhna: "sinh" ek hi naam hai, bilkul "sin" ki tarah.
2. Yeh sochna ke hyperbolic functions bhi \(\sin x\) ki tarah periodic (baar baar dohraane wale) hain: nahin, yeh exponentials se bane hain jo kabhi dohraate nahin.
3. \(\sinh^{-1} x\) ko \(\frac{1}{\sinh x}\) samajh lena: yahan \(-1\) ka matlab inverse function hai, reciprocal nahin.
